title: RLUSD September independent reserve attestation versus October 29 live issuer dashboard

research_window.note: Source pages and PDF were inspected through rendered web text and a page image. Original PDF/HTTP bytes and response headers were not preserved in this run.

source_capture_policy.reason: The CPA report is primary independent attestation evidence, but this run retained rendered text/image rather than byte-complete PDF and issuer-dashboard payloads. RLUSD reserve measurements are not XRP market-price, XRP collateral or XRP flow features.

limitations: The page labels balances as of October 29, 2026 but does not expose an exact dashboard retrieval timestamp in the rendered capture.
The latest linked independent reserve attestation on the page is September 2026, not an October 29 attestation.
Live dashboard balances are issuer-published and must not be described as independently attested October 29 balances.
The page does not disclose chain-by-chain RLUSD circulating supply or XRP settlement volume.

source_registry.publisher: Standard Custody & Trust Company, LLC; independent CPA report
limitations: The CPA report examines management's assertion at two historical report dates; it is not a continuous reserve audit.
The report does not disclose each depository institution or custody counterparty by name in the rendered reserve table.
A fair-presentation opinion on the specified dates does not independently attest later live dashboard balances.

issuer_and_regulatory_scope.charter: New York limited purpose trust company supervised by NYDFS
issuer_and_regulatory_scope.reserve_requirement: 100% backing by highly liquid, transparent reserve assets under the issuer's stated NYDFS framework
issuer_and_regulatory_scope.network_approval_limitation: Approved network status does not establish actual circulating supply, settlement volume, collateral use or XRP purchases on any specific network.

independently_attested_reserve_snapshots.independent_accountant_opinion: Management's assertion that the RLUSD Reserve Report is presented in accordance with its criteria is fairly stated, in all material respects, as of the two report dates.
reserve_asset_criteria: US Treasury bills acquired three months or less from maturity
Overnight reverse repurchase agreements fully collateralized by US Treasury bills, notes or bonds, subject to NYDFS-approved conditions
Government money-market funds subject to NYDFS-approved caps and restrictions
Deposits at US state- or federally chartered depository institutions subject to NYDFS-approved restrictions
independently_attested_reserve_snapshots.segregation: The report states that the reserve is segregated from the proprietary assets of the issuing entity.
independently_attested_reserve_snapshots.interpretation: The two CPA-attested dates show reserve assets above outstanding RLUSD units. The report's displayed actual composition consists of US Treasury bills, government money-market funds, regulated-institution cash deposits and a timing adjustment; it does not identify XRP as a reserve asset.

issuer_dashboard_snapshot.interpretation: The issuer dashboard's October 29 figures imply approximately 105.01% reserve coverage, but the latest linked CPA report only attests September 21 and September 30. The October 29 calculation is an issuer-dashboard observation, not an independently attested reserve ratio.

groups: Independent CPA examination of Standard Custody management assertion
source_independence.limitation: The independent CPA report examines issuer management's reserve assertion and source records; it is stronger assurance than an issuer-only dashboard, but it is not an independent continuous market feed.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: RLUSD circulation and reserve growth can indicate adoption of Ripple's stablecoin without implying incremental XRP demand.
supporting_evidence: Issuer dashboard reports $2.627B RLUSD circulation as of October 29.
RLUSD reserve assets are USD-denominated cash equivalents and short-dated US government instruments.
disconfirming_or_missing: No chain-by-chain circulation or settlement-volume split was disclosed in the captured dashboard.
No matching XRP purchase, bridge, DEX or payment-rail flow was established.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: At the September 21 and September 30 report dates, the independent CPA report supports reserve assets exceeding outstanding RLUSD units.
supporting_evidence: The independent accountant states management's assertion is fairly stated in all material respects.
disconfirming_or_missing: Only two historical report dates are attested.
The report does not attest the October 29 dashboard snapshot.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The October 29 issuer dashboard implies a reserve ratio near 105.01%, but independent confirmation for that date is not yet linked.
supporting_evidence: Dashboard displays $2.7586B reserves and $2.627B circulating RLUSD.
disconfirming_or_missing: Latest linked CPA report is for September 30.
No October 29 reserve attestation was captured.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: NYDFS-approved network scope establishes where RLUSD may be supported under the issuer's framework, not actual distribution or XRP settlement on each network.
supporting_evidence: The September report lists XRPL, Ethereum, Base, Unichain, Optimism, Ink and XRPL EVM Sidechain as NYDFS-approved networks.
disconfirming_or_missing: No chain-specific outstanding-unit table or transfer/settlement volume was disclosed in the captured report.

reasons: RLUSD reserve balances are not XRP balances or XRP collateral.
The October 29 dashboard snapshot is not covered by the latest linked CPA attestation.
No chain-specific RLUSD supply or XRP settlement volume was captured.
Original PDF and dashboard response bytes, SHA-256 receipts and independent timestamp anchors were not retained.
Stablecoin adoption and reserve coverage do not establish XRP price direction.

next_actions: Retain the original signed CPA PDF as a byte-complete raw source when a permitted capture route is available, and record SHA-256 plus receipt timestamp.
Capture each subsequent monthly RLUSD attestation as a separate point-in-time vintage.
Capture chain-specific RLUSD supply and transfer data from XRPL and other approved networks without treating network approval as usage.
Reconcile RLUSD mint/redemption and XRPL settlement records against actual XRP ledger and exchange-flow evidence before considering any XRP feature.
Keep RLUSD reserve assets separate from XRP collateral, XRP holdings and XRP purchases.
